subject.title: feat(plugins): order Featured catalog by recency

question: Should OpenClaw make ClawHub-controlled `featuredAt` a durable optional Gateway catalog field for recency-based Featured curation?
rationale: The patch is additive and retains legacy fallbacks, but it expands the cross-repository catalog contract and requires an owner decision on curation metadata and producer deployment responsibility.

options.title: Approve the optional curation contract
options.body: Accept `featuredAt` as optional hosted catalog metadata once direct Control UI behavior proof is added and the ClawHub producer deployment is confirmed.

options.title: Keep existing catalog ordering
options.body: Decline the new cross-repository metadata contract and retain the current `order` and name-based Featured ordering.

recommendation.title: Approve the optional curation contract
recommendation.body: Accept `featuredAt` as optional hosted catalog metadata once direct Control UI behavior proof is added and the ClawHub producer deployment is confirmed.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the available cross-repository contributor connected to both the consumer implementation and the linked producer change, and can provide the contract details for maintainer approval.
